name: Lumina

frame.name: Noble Rounds
frame.description: Kills with this weapon leave behind Remnants. Absorbing a Remnant converts your next hipfired shot into an ally-seeking Noble Round and partially refills the magazine.

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.description:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Blessing of the Sky
perks.description: Using a Noble Round on an ally heals them and grants both you and them a weapon damage bonus for a short duration.

perks.name: Polymer Grip
perks.description:
This weapon's grip is made of lighter material.
  •  Increases handling speed

flavor: There must be meaning in my roar.

catalyst.name: Lumina Catalyst
catalyst.description: Gain two Remnants per final blow instead of one.
